precedence: POLICY_SKIP only with explicit hard-blocker evidence
NEEDS_DETAIL_REVIEW when Full JD/detail evidence is missing or failed
fail_open_rules: Missing Full JD never becomes POLICY_SKIP by itself.
Unknown sponsorship never becomes POLICY_SKIP by itself.
Unknown salary or contract never becomes POLICY_SKIP by itself.
Preferred MRI or adjacent methods are not blockers.
Ambiguous title or domain routes to review.
One source/shard failure never implies a vacancy is closed.

separation_of_concerns.collector: collect and enrich source evidence; no final scientific-fit decision
separation_of_concerns.evaluator_stage7: scientific fit, level fit, methods, language, mobility and other dimensions
separation_of_concerns.finalizer: combine evidence, provenance, dedupe, evaluation and state
